title: Nerv Adapter Capabilities
description: Schema for per-adapter capabilities.yaml files. Declares which events a CLI supports natively, which require synthesis, and which are unsupported. Used by nerv doctor, hook skip logic, and adapter codegen.

cli_version_range.description: Semver range this capability map applies to.

native.description: Events natively supported by this CLI — no synthesis needed.

synthesized.description: Events the adapter can synthesize. Keyed by event name.

unsupported.description: Events that cannot be provided — no native support, no feasible workaround.

close.description: Events with close-but-not-exact native mappings. Semantic mismatch acknowledged.

synthesis_entry.description: How a single event is synthesized by the adapter.

pattern.description: Regex or match expression used for matcher-based synthesis.

via.description: Source event used to synthesize this event.

cost.description: Runtime cost of this synthesis technique.

notes.description: Additional context about limitations or caveats.

close_entry.description: An event with a close-but-not-exact native mapping.

source.description: Native CLI event that approximates this nerv event.
